## Question 4 (2 points)

On any given day, there is a 60% chance that it rains. If it rains, there is an 80% chance you will drive and a 20% chance you will take the bus to work. If it doesn't rain, there is a 30% chance you will drive and a 70% chance you will take the bus to work. Complete the code below to estimate the probability that, on any given day, you drive to work.

```{r, echo = TRUE}
set.seed(100)

N <- 100000
count <- 0

for (i in 1:N){
  rains <- sample(c("Yes", "No"), 1, prob = c(0.6, 0.4))
  
  if (rains == "Yes"){
    drives <- sample(c("Yes", "No"), 1, prob = c(0.8, 0.2))
  } else if (rains == "No"){
    drives <- sample(c("Yes", "No"), 1, prob = c(0.3, 0.7))
  }
  
  # Fill in the missing piece of code here
  {
    count <- count + 1
  }
}

count/N
```
